justification: Switch PCO query from 7-day to 35-day window so monthly cron never misses amendments. Same API, wider date range, graceful fallback.

pre_impl.reason: Swap one PCO client function for another already-built one. No new DB queries, no schema changes.

functions: check_via_pco() now calls get_changes_since(35 days) instead of get_weekly_changes(), with fallback to weekly on error

break_it.scenario: PCO custom date query endpoint returns error or different format
break_it.what_happens: Exception caught, falls back to get_weekly_changes() with a log line
break_it.repro: Mock get_changes_since to raise, verify fallback fires
break_it.how: try/except with explicit fallback to the previous behaviour

break_it.scenario: 35-day window returns thousands of results, slow response
break_it.what_happens: Larger JSON payload but still a single HTTP GET with 30s timeout in pco_client._request()
break_it.repro: Run from whitelisted IP after a busy legislative period
break_it.how: PCO export is pre-filtered server-side; NSW publishes ~5-20 instrument changes per month

post_merge.manual_verify: Trigger legislation monitor from Fly.io, confirm log shows '35 days' not 'this week'
